ideas.name: Refillable desk glue/paste pot with paper-pod refills
ideas.concept: Glass/metal desk glue pot plus plant-starch paste refill pouches in paper packaging.
ideas.target_customer: Parents of 4-10 year olds, teachers, craft hobbyists in SE/DK
ideas.problem_solved: Plastic glue sticks are single-use and dry out.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: web search and Firecrawl were unavailable (budget/credits exhausted); idea is from general knowledge of plastic-free stationery interest.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Proprietary pot design plus formulation spec and refill subscription.
ideas.tooling_needed: Stock glass jar plus custom lid; no moulds
